{{Quote|Meet Imperial courier Val Tula. She'll have a datadisc for you. It's a valuable item, so watch yourself once you make the pickup.|[[Bardo Klinj]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BK" />}}
'''Val Tula''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Courier/Legends|courier]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was assigned to the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. There, she served under a corrupted Imperial official acquainted with the [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]].<ref name="SWG:BK" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the official wanted to send a package to Borvo who did a big favor to him. The official dispatched Val Tula to deliver the package to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] employed by [[Bardo Klinj]], Borvo's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]]. During the delivery, Tula and the spacer were attacked by a thug of [[Kritus Morven's gang]], Borvo's enemies, but the individual was able to eliminate the aggressor. The spacer eventually brought the package containing Imperial export permits to Bardo Klinj.<ref name="SWG:BK" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateImperialOfficerM.png|200px|thumb|Incorrect depiction of Val Tula as a male]]
Val Tula was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Val Tula was involved in the second quest given by Bardo Klinj on Naboo. Although she was described as a female, she was depicted as a generic [[Human/Legends|Human]] male Imperial officer.<ref name="SWG:BK" />
